152	    const entries = Object.entries(data).map(([userId, value]) => {
153	      if (typeof value === 'string') {
154	        return [
155	          userId,
156	          {
157	            context_token: value,
158	            updated_at: new Date(0).toISOString(),
159	          },
160	        ] as const
161	      }
162	
163	      const record = value as Partial<ContextTokenRecord>
164	      return [
165	        userId,
166	        {
167	          context_token: record.context_token ?? '',
168	          updated_at: record.updated_at ?? new Date(0).toISOString(),
169	        },
170	      ] as const
171	    }).filter(([, value]) => value.context_token)
172	    return new Map(entries)

175	  }

183	  try {
184	    if (!existsSync(POLLER_STATE_PATH)) {
185	      return {
186	        get_updates_buf: '',

191	    return {

193	      updated_at: data.updated_at ?? new Date(0).toISOString(),

244	      {

247	        inputSchema: {

261	        },
262	      },
263	    ],
264	  }))

267	    if (req.params.name === 'wechat_reply') {
268	      const { from_user_id, text } = req.params.arguments as {
269	        from_user_id: string
270	        text: string
271	      }
272	      const tokenRecord = contextTokens.get(from_user_id)
273	      if (!tokenRecord?.context_token) {

3	A [Claude Code channel](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/channels-reference) that bridges your personal WeChat account to a Claude Code session via Tencent's [iLink bot API](https://ilinkai.weixin.qq.com). Two-way messaging with permission relay support.
4	
5	## Features
6	
7	- **Two-way chat** — WeChat messages arrive in Claude's context; Claude replies back to WeChat
8	- **Permission relay** — tool-approval prompts are forwarded to WeChat so you can approve/deny remotely
9	- **QR code login** — scan with WeChat to authenticate, credentials persist locally
10	- **Sender allowlist** — restrict which WeChat users can reach your session
11	- **Cursor persistence** — poller state survives reconnects so no messages are missed
12	
13	## Prerequisites
14	
15	- [Bun](https://bun.sh) runtime (v1.3+)
16	- [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com) v2.1.81+
17	- A personal WeChat account
18	
19	## Installation
20	
21	### Via Plugin Marketplace (recommended)
22	
23	Add the marketplace and install:
24	
25	```bash
26	# Add the marketplace
27	/plugin marketplace add uetuluk/cc-wechat
28	
29	# Install the plugin
30	/plugin install cc-wechat@cc-wechat
31	```
32	
33	Then start Claude Code with the channel enabled:
34	
35	```bash
36	claude --channels plugin:cc-wechat@cc-wechat
37	```
38	
39	> **Note:** During the research preview, custom channels require the development flag:
40	> ```bash
41	> claude --dangerously-load-development-channels plugin:cc-wechat@cc-wechat
42	> ```
43	
44	### Via Local Plugin Directory
45	
46	```bash
47	git clone https://github.com/uetuluk/cc-wechat.git
48	cd cc-wechat
49	bun install
50	
51	claude --plugin-dir . --dangerously-load-development-channels server:wechat
52	```
53	
54	### Via npm
55	
56	```bash
57	npm install -g @uetuluk/cc-wechat
58	```
59	
60	## Setup
61	
62	On first run, a QR code dialog appears in Claude Code — scan it with WeChat to log in. Credentials are saved locally for subsequent sessions.
63	
64	## How It Works
65	
66	```
67	WeChat App <-> iLink API (ilinkai.weixin.qq.com) <-> This channel (local) <-> Claude Code (stdio)
68	```
69	
70	The channel runs as an MCP server spawned by Claude Code. It polls WeChat's iLink long-polling endpoint for inbound messages and uses the MCP notification system to forward them to Claude.
71	
72	- WeChat messages arrive in Claude's context as `<channel source="wechat" from_user_id="...">` tags
73	- Claude replies using the `wechat_reply` tool
74	- Permission prompts forward to WeChat; respond with `yes <id>` or `no <id>`
75	
76	## Sender Allowlist
77	
78	Edit `access.json` to restrict which WeChat users can message Claude:
79	
80	```json
81	{
82	  "allowed_senders": ["user123@im.wechat"]
83	}
84	```
85	
86	An empty list allows all senders (useful during initial setup to discover your user ID from the channel tags).
87	
88	## Configuration
89	
90	| File | Purpose |
91	|------|---------|
92	| `.mcp.json` | MCP server config (command + args) |
93	| `credentials.json` | Saved bot token (auto-created on login) |
94	| `access.json` | Sender allowlist |
95	| `.context-tokens.json` | Persisted context tokens for replies |
96	| `.poller-state.json` | Polling cursor (survives restarts) |
97	
98	## Architecture
99	
100	```
101	src/
102	  wechat-channel.ts   # Entry point: MCP server + orchestration
103	  ilink-client.ts     # iLink HTTP client (login, poll, send)
104	  poller.ts           # Long-poll loop with cursor management
105	  types.ts            # TypeScript types for iLink API
106	```
107	
108	## Development
109	
110	```bash
111	bun install
112	bun test
113	bun run typecheck
114	```

15	function makeHeaders(token?: string): Record<string, string> {
16	  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
17	    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
18	    AuthorizationType: 'ilink_bot_token',
19	    'X-WECHAT-UIN': btoa(String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 0xFFFFFFFF))),
20	    'iLink-App-Id': ILINK_APP_ID,
21	    'iLink-App-ClientVersion': ILINK_APP_CLIENT_VERSION,
22	  }
23	  if (token) {
24	    headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`
25	  }
26	  return headers
27	}

29	export function createILinkClient(token?: string, baseUrl: string = ILINK_BASE_URL) {
30	  function makeBaseInfo() {
31	    return { channel_version: CHANNEL_VERSION }
32	  }
33	
34	  return {
35	    async getQrCode(): Promise<QrCodeResponse> {
36	      const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/ilink/bot/get_bot_qrcode?bot_type=3`, {
37	        headers: makeHeaders(),
38	      })
39	      return res.json()
40	    },
41	
42	    async pollQrStatus(qrcode: string): Promise<QrStatusResponse> {
43	      const res = await fetch(
44	        `${baseUrl}/ilink/bot/get_qrcode_status?qrcode=${encodeURIComponent(qrcode)}`,
45	        { headers: makeHeaders() },
46	      )
47	      return res.json()
48	    },
49	
50	    async getUpdates(cursor: string): Promise<GetUpdatesResponse> {
51	      const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/ilink/bot/getupdates`, {
52	        method: 'POST',
53	        headers: makeHeaders(token),
54	        body: JSON.stringify({
55	          get_updates_buf: cursor,
56	          base_info: makeBaseInfo(),
57	        }),
58	      })
59	      return res.json()
60	    },
61	
62	    async sendMessage(
63	      toUserId: string,
64	      contextToken: string,
65	      text: string,
66	    ): Promise<SendMessageResponse> {
67	      const body = JSON.stringify({
68	        msg: {
69	          from_user_id: '',
70	          to_user_id: toUserId,
71	          client_id: `claude-code-wechat-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
72	          message_type: 2,
73	          message_state: 2,
74	          context_token: contextToken,
75	          item_list: text ? [{ type: 1, text_item: { text } }] : undefined,
76	        },

83	          ...makeHeaders(token),

85	        },
86	        body,
87	      })

89	    },
